name: Export Promotion Capital Goods Scheme
benefit:
EPCG Scheme allows import of capital goods for pre-production, production and post-production at Zero customs duty & IGST.
**The specific export obligation may be reduced for the EPCG authorisation holder, in the following cases:**

1. In cases, where they have completed 75% or more of specific export obligation and 100% of average export obligation till date (if any), in half or less than hal
_eligibility_text: **Pre-conditions for applying for EPCG:** 1. IEC Entity has already Imported Items by paying customs duty. 1. The applicant has an ‘Active’ IEC and is logged into the DGFT Customer Portal. 1. E-Sign and DSC are enabled for submission. 1. The applicant is authorised to draft and submit applications for an IEC. 1. GSTN details corresponding to the branches of the IEC. The same may be added from Services > IEC Profile Management > Modify IEC.
